tspan.tspan: Gold beat every other asset in both 2024 and 2025
Calendar‐year returns in rupees, 2016 to 2025, best first:
Source: NSE, CME and S&P via Yahoo Finance; Zerodha calculations
Price indices, so dividends are not counted. Gold is the COMEX price and the S&P 500 its index level,
each turned into rupees at the year‐end exchange rate; Dollar is the rupee price of one US dollar.
For each year, the six assets are listed from the best return to the worst. Gold is the
orange cell and the Nifty 50 the blue‐bordered one, so you can follow where each ranked year by year.
